standard.summary: Latent 统计对照不代表身份或风格语义准确率；CLIP 仅沿 Anima 既有解码路径。
standard.effect: 不同枚举会改变算法目标、资源占用或导出兼容性。
standard.whenToUse: 先默认，再按显存/质量/兼容目标换档。
standard.avoidWhen: 未做短测对照前不要同时叠多个激进实验档。

optionDescriptions.latent_style_contrast: 用 latent 风格对比打分。
optionDescriptions.clip_text_similarity: 用 CLIP 文图相似度打分。

standard_en.summary: Latent statistics do not establish identity or style accuracy. CLIP uses the existing Anima decoding route only.
standard_en.effect: Different enum values change the algorithm's target, its resource use, or export compatibility.
standard_en.whenToUse: Start on the default, then change gear according to your VRAM, quality or compatibility goal.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not stack several aggressive experimental gears before running a short controlled test.

advanced.principle: 类别来自最终选中的 JSON caption；新缓存保存类别，旧缓存无类别时跳过，可显式重建补齐。sigma 筛选后按类别选择样本。Latent scorer 比较统计特征，不产生自动身份/风格语义标签。

advanced_en.principle: Categories follow the selected JSON caption and cache variant. Legacy caches without metadata are skipped until explicitly rebuilt. Each category uses its own samples within the sigma window; latent statistics are not semantic labels.
